snippet.title: Mina the Hollower – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch & Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Mina the Hollower is coming to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 on Oct 31, 2025! Play the demo now: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/mina-the-hollower-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01

Descend into a frightful world of action-adventure in Mina the Hollower. Play as Mina, a renowned Hollower, hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Burrow beneath hazards and monsters, whip foes into oblivion, and gear up with an arsenal of sidearms and trinkets.

#MinaTheHollower #NintendoSwitch #NintendoSwitch2 #IndieWorld

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
